content:
Claude is upgrading its Chrome sidebar into a full Cowork session, allowing browser-based tasks and conversations to continue seamlessly across users' other Claude apps.

Claude can now bring browser tasks into all its apps

Anthropic announced the change today. Conversations initiated in the sidebar are now saved to Claude conversation history, and users can continue them from Claude's desktop, web, and mobile apps.

Skills and connectors already configured for an account are now available in the browser with no additional setup. Claude in Chrome can read the current page content and perform actions through the user's existing browser logins, including clicking links, switching pages, entering text, and filling out forms.

Anthropic's example involves a user asking Claude to collect invoice data from multiple vendor platforms, build a spreadsheet, and then continue the same session on desktop to add local files or compare results against past budgets.

The update closes a gap in Claude's browser workflow. Sidebar sessions were previously siloed from conversations in Claude's other apps, with no sharing of conversation content or context.

Anthropic has also recently showcased the in-app browser for Claude Code, which uses a separate profile. The Chrome extension, by contrast, can operate on sites where the user is already logged in.

Anthropic warns that browser agents remain susceptible to prompt injection attacks.

A separate review will examine high-impact actions when auto-approval is enabled, while operations involving purchases or sharing personal data still require user consent from Claude.

The company says these safeguards reduce risk but cannot eliminate it entirely.

Availability

The Cowork sidebar is available to Max and Team customers starting today, with Pro users expected to roll out over the coming weeks. Enterprise admins can enable the feature and restrict access to approved domains. Claude in Chrome does not yet support other Chromium browsers or mobile devices.

The release continues Anthropic's push to make Claude workflows seamless across platforms.

Recent additions include live testing of Claude Code for Mac's iOS app, as well as new Opus 4.8 controls for running longer jobs across more products and devices.
